rule: Hold 20 percent each in SPY, EFA, IEF, GSG and VNQ. At the last NYSE trading day of each month hold a sleeve only if its dividend-adjusted close exceeds the mean of its last 10 month-end closes, otherwise cash at 0. Fill at next open, trading only on signal changes or when a held sleeve drifts more than 25 percent from target.
known_limits: Benchmark is the same five ETFs equal-weight, rebalanced annually. Cash earns 0. Assumes fractional shares. US-domiciled ETFs may be unavailable to EU retail accounts.
